dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Midnight is at risk due to behavioral reasons. In his previous home, Midnight was reported to escalate to biting when in the possession of toys and other items and when the owner attempted to groom him. Midnight would escalate to snapping or biting when they attempted to bath him, brush his coat, or touch the matted hair. During intake, Midnight was observed to bare teeth, growl, and lunge towards handlers. While in care, Midnight is noted to dodge the leash while baring teeth. Midnight's previous owner describes him as a couch potato that enjoys car rides. Medically, Midnight has nuclear sclerosis.

Midnight arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as a couch potato that enjoys car rides. During intake, Midnight was observed to bare teeth, growl, and lunge towards handlers. In his previous home, Midnight was reported to escalate to biting when in the possession of toys and other items and when the owner attempted to groom him. Midnight would escalate to snapping or biting when they attempted to bath him, brush his coat, or touch the matted hair. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
